offering_description.value: Places and operates video gaming terminals and amusement devices in licensed bars, restaurants, taverns and truck stops under revenue-share agreements. Also owns and operates its own gaming locations and provides cash access services.

primary_products.value: video gaming terminals; skill games; amusement devices

primary_services.value: gaming terminal placement and route operations; terminal servicing; gaming location operation; cash access services

customer_segment.value: B2B: licensed bars, restaurants, taverns, truck stops hosting terminals; B2C: gaming patrons at company-owned gaming locations

end_markets.value: gaming; hospitality; bars and restaurants; truck stops

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: share of net terminal income from terminals placed in partner locations; other: gaming revenue from company-owned gaming locations; service fees: fees for ATM and cash access services
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; other; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates gaming terminals bought from manufacturers, placed in third-party venues and own locations

geography_served.value: US regional: Illinois, Montana, Nevada, Nebraska, Pennsylvania, Georgia and other licensed states

specialization.value: related lines: route gaming terminals, owned gaming locations and cash access services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales force signing venue partners to terminal use agreements; own locations: company-operated gaming locations

regulatory_exposure.value: high: gaming licenses required, state gaming boards such as Illinois Gaming Board and Nevada Gaming Control Board
